title: meteorbee's blockier font
description: Makes the font blockier! Read it with a glance :D
body:
# Ever wanted to be able to read the font with just a glance?

With this texturepack the font gets made blockier, making it easier to read quickly. Good for times when you dont have time to deal with the base font.

With 2 different releases, you can find an option that works for you!

![The Resourcepacks Logo (Using the font)](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/977cdccd7d2d995230e4621c48592b60ac75e5e8_0.webp)
